See

Trump Signs Executive Order To Reclassify Marijuana By Removing It From Schedule I

 

For a month or so the hardcore Prohibitionist chorus has been hysterically claiming that even talking about rescheduling would send the wrong message to children, and newborns would be required to smoke superdoobies of rocketship weed that has been genetically modified to 200% THC. Or something like that.

See

The Shocking Truth About Big Marijuana (Weed) (Dope)

And links.

 

Obviously, I am in favor of rescheduling, or, better yet, descheduling.

See

Washington Post “Legalize It”. We Are Living In A Simpsons Simulation

 

But that is not on the agenda.

 

In the meantime, Trump, who is never restrained by Constitutional niceties when he really wants something, has simply ordered the DEA et al. to implement his order. Bureaucracies are very good at slow dancing.

See

The Complicated Politics of Trump’s Medical Cannabis Policies

 

In the meantime, what America really needs is a discussion of how Cannabis was originally put in Schedule 1, without any scientific evidence.

See Heritage and Harvard and the War on Truth and Freedom

 

I don’t usually give medical advice, but I would make one suggestion: Don’t hold your breath!!
